svg.text: Flat plate 150 mm long, 60 mm wide at the back (it fits between the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side plates), 400 mm wide at the front where it meets the bulkhead.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hole 34.5 mm, 90 mm from the back edge: the headset cup spigot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back edges: one tab and one T-slot each side. Front edge: 4 tabs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: T-slot: 9 mm wide, 23 deep, with a 13.6 x 8.4 mm window 10 mm in for the nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: it lies flat on top of the head tube; the upper headset cup's flange

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holds it down on the tube end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
